meta.name: ai-act-readiness
meta.description: /cs:ai-act-readiness <system> — EU AI Act 6-question forcing interrogation. Use during AI-system intake, before EU deployment, or during annual compliance refresh as Article 113 obligations phase in (2025-02-02 / 2025-08-02 / 2026-08-02 / 2027-08-02).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI系统是否符合欧盟AI法案要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保AI系统符合欧盟AI法案的合规要求。
copy.tagline_en: Assess AI system compliance with EU AI Act requirements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your AI system meets EU AI Act obligations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你回答欧盟 AI 法案的 6 个强制问题，判断你的 AI 系统是否被禁止、是否高风险、该走哪种合规路径，并输出一份合规报告。
howto.when: 当你准备在欧盟部署 AI 系统、进行年度合规审查，或系统发生重大变更时，输入 /cs:ai-act-readiness <系统名称> 即可触发。

say.text: 帮我评估这个新聊天机器人是否符合欧盟 AI 法案。
say.note: Claude 会启动 6 个问题流程，逐步询问系统细节。

say.text: 检查我们的人脸识别系统是否属于高风险。
say.note: Claude 会运行风险分类脚本并给出结论。

say.text: 我们公司从部署者变成了提供者，需要更新合规义务。
say.note: Claude 会重新评估角色并调整义务矩阵。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through 6 mandatory EU AI Act questions to determine if your AI system is prohibited, high-risk, or which conformity route to take, and output a compliance report.
howto.when_en: Triggered by entering /cs:ai-act-readiness <system> when preparing to deploy an AI system in the EU, during annual compliance review, or after a material change.

say_en.text: Assess this new chatbot for EU AI Act compliance.
Check if our facial recognition system is high-risk.
say_en.note: Claude will run the risk classification script and give a verdict.

say_en.text: We changed from deployer to provider, update obligations.
say_en.note: Claude will reassess the role and adjust the obligation matrix.
